lines.text: Owning this yacht costs about eight thousand dollars a day.
Fifty meters. Thirty million dollars. Champagne in Saint-Tropez.
The crew, about a dozen people: one to two million a year.
Maintenance and repairs: seven hundred grand, minimum.
Fuel: a quarter million. Double that if you actually cruise.
A Riviera berth: up to three hundred fifty grand.
The industry rule: ten percent of the price, every year. Three million dollars.
Ten years in, you've paid for it twice. Still want the yacht?

footnote: Estimates for a ~50 m yacht (10–15% of value per year). Sources: Fraser Yachts, Ocean Independence (2026).
